title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.08363v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. translated_title: StrataFlux：内存层次结构原生的低比特大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 量化降低了大语言模型（LLM）推理的内存和带宽需求，但可能导致精度下降；而卸载更高精度的数据反而会使生成过程停滞。我们提出了 StrataFlux，这是一个打破这种权衡的框架，它能够恢复因低比特权重和键值（KV）缓存量化而损失的精度，同时保留量化在内存和速度方面的优势。StrataFlux 通过联合设计精化表示、选择和交付机制，使主机内存（RAM）和固态硬盘成为提供额外精度的有效来源。其选择性精度流式传输减少了数据传输量，将数据交付与计算过程重叠进行，并在多个解码步骤中复用已获取的精度信息，使生成过程无需等待每一次传输。我们在专用 GPU 和统一内存平台上评估了 2-4 比特权重和 2-3 比特 KV 缓存的方案。对于 2 比特的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 权重，StrataFlux 将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 9.46 降低到 8.40，同时保持……
tldr: StrataFlux 框架通过从主机内存和固态硬盘进行选择性精度流式传输，并让数据交付与计算重叠、跨解码步骤复用精度信息，在保留量化内存和速度优势的同时，有效恢复了低比特权重和 KV 缓存量化导致的 LLM 推理精度损失。
en_tdlr: StrataFlux recovers accuracy lost to low-bit weight and KV-cache quantization in LLM inference by selectively streaming precision from host RAM and SSDs—with delivery overlapped on computation and precision reused across decoding steps—while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages.
